program: SNAP — Kansas calls it the Food Assistance program; DCF's own consumer pages use "Food Assistance," not "SNAP," as the primary label (see PROVENANCE.md)
agency: Kansas Department for Children and Families (DCF)
admin_note: Kansas is a STATE-ADMINISTERED SNAP program — DCF administers directly through the Kansas Eligibility Enforcement System (KEES), with no county option-in like CA/NY/MN/WI/VA. This pack found a genuinely consequential DISCREPANCY worth flagging up front: this repo's existing packages/snap-rules StatePolicy entry for KS is explicitly labeled "Non-BBCE archetype (e.g. KS)" in its own `label` field, and the file's top-of-file comment (states.ts line ~128) states "Other states (TX/KS/AK) are policy archetypes used by the fixture; their SUA values are illustrative until the FNS-published values are loaded" — language signaling a SYNTHETIC placeholder, not independently researched real Kansas policy. This pack's own independent primary-source research (KEESM, the Kansas Economic and Employment Support Manual, plus the current KEESM Appendix F-2 Food Assistance Program Standards PDF, effective 10/1/2025-9/30/2026, and K.S.A. 39-709e) CONFIRMS the existing engine's `bbce: false`, `asset_waiver: false`, and SUA figures (HCSUA $469 / LUA $345 / phone $44) as ACCURATE, current, real Kansas policy, not an arbitrary placeholder — real Kansas SUA figures happen to exactly match what a synthetic-archetype label implied. This pack also found a SEPARATE, undated in-code comment directly above the KS entry (states.ts lines ~1037-1042) that already claims "confirmed live 2026-08-09" for the SUA figures via KEESM §7226 — an apparent partial, undocumented prior correction that was never reconciled with the file's own "archetype"/"illustrative" language one screen above it. See PROVENANCE.md for the full discrepancy-resolution writeup; packages/snap-rules is NOT touched by this corpus-only pack.
system: DCF processes Food Assistance centrally through KEES (Kansas Eligibility Enforcement System); applicants apply online at cssp.kees.ks.gov, by phone through the DCF Consumer Assistance Line (1-888-369-4777), in person at a local DCF service center, or by mailing a paper Application for Benefits (ES-3100). Most non-elderly/non-disabled households recertify on a 12-month cycle; this pack could not confirm a Kansas-specific interim/periodic-report structure with primary-source confidence (see freshness.json).
